page.intro_en: The Bihar Staff Selection Commission (BSSC) has announced the written examination date for Stenographer and Steno Typist Grade - III posts under Advertisement Number 07/25. The computer-based test is scheduled for 01 December 2026 in two shifts. Registered candidates can check their exam city details starting from 24 November 2026 and download their admit cards from 27 November 2026 using their registration number and date of birth on the official website.
